# Scientific American

> > Scientific American (SciAm) is a leading science journalism publication covering research, discovery, and innovation across all scientific disciplines.

Published by Springer Nature America, Inc., Scientific American offers both digital and print subscriptions with content accessible via ScientificAmerican.com and mobile apps for iOS and Android. The publication also produces documentary series like "The Protectors" focusing on wildlife conservation and endangered species.

## Subscription & Access

- [Be in Awe of the World. Read SciAm.](https://scientificamerican.com/getsciam): Scientific American subscription plans with digital and print options

## Special Projects & Opportunities

- [Call for Proposals: "The Protectors" A Documentary Series](https://scientificamerican.com/page/call-for-proposals-the-protectors-a-documentary-series-by-scientific-american): Film funding opportunity for wildlife conservation documentaries ($80K)
